## Attendance

The programme board met in August 2019. Present: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and outstanding work for the period. There were 190 captures. The grader backlog was 22, and the letter bureau position was 0.

The board noted these figures and agreed that they provided a clear view of current workload and outstanding processing. No additional performance concerns were raised during the meeting.

## Items

Routine business was considered. The board discussed the reported activity and the position on backlog and letters. No further matters were recorded for escalation.

The board noted that the current position should continue to be monitored through the usual reporting arrangements. Members were invited to raise any subsequent issues with the chair for consideration.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions arising from the meeting. Members will continue to monitor the grader backlog and letter bureau position and provide updates through the established programme board process.
